purpose: Define controlled scenario coverage for property evidence fixture revalidation so common correction, provenance, privacy, supersession and rejection paths are explicitly tested.
required_assertions: Every scenario creates or references an explicit impact event.
Affected dependencies are resolved from the dependency registry.
Proposition scope remains limited to mapped dependencies.
Privacy-impacting changes block affected use until review passes.
Source-derived provenance changes require provenance review.
Superseded fixtures cannot silently remain active.
Rejected fixtures cannot be used for active validation.
No scenario automatically makes a pathway publication-ready.
guardrails: Scenario coverage validates system behavior, not the correctness of Irish property law.
Fixtures used in these scenarios may be synthetic and cannot establish real property facts.
Scenario results must not be interpreted as live official-record evidence.
